name: Backend Engineer Opportunity Scout
description: Starter jobs profile: early-to-mid-level backend and platform software engineering roles in Bengaluru, or remote roles that explicitly allow working from India. Copy it to my-search/jobs.json and adapt it.
targetEntity: An actively hiring product or engineering-led company with a Bengaluru-based role or an India-compatible remote role worldwide, offering an individual-contributor SDE, Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Distributed Systems Engineer, Platform Engineer, or backend-heavy Product or Full-stack Engineer opening at SDE 1 to SDE 2 scope

criteria.label: Software engineering role fit
criteria.description: The opening is a hands-on individual-contributor software engineering role. Primary matches are SDE, SDE 1, SDE 2, Software Engineer I or II, Backend Engineer, Distributed Systems Engineer, Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Software Engineer, or a backend-heavy Product or Full-stack Engineer.

criteria.label: Backend and distributed-systems fit
criteria.description: The work substantially overlaps with backend services, distributed systems, microservices, request or message routing, load balancing, fault tolerance, observability, performance, networking, APIs, WebSockets, queues, caching, or platform engineering.

criteria.label: SDE 1 to SDE 2 seniority fit
criteria.description: The role is entry-to-mid-level and rewards demonstrated ownership and technical depth. Typical acceptable bands are 2-5 years or equivalent capability. Roles asking for slightly more experience remain eligible when the responsibilities align; staff, principal, architect, and people-manager scope does not.

criteria.label: Location and authorization fit
criteria.description: The role is based in Bengaluru (on-site, hybrid, or remote), or is remote from any company location while explicitly accepting candidates working from India through direct employment, an employer-of-record, or a compliant contractor arrangement. Required working hours must be sustainable from India.

criteria.label: Language and stack fit
criteria.description: The role uses TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Java, C++, SQL, AWS, Docker, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or a comparable backend stack. TypeScript and Node.js are the strongest immediate fit; Java, C++, Go, or Python roles qualify when they accept transferable systems experience.

criteria.label: Meaningful engineering ownership
criteria.description: The engineer will own production features, services, architecture, performance, reliability, or end-to-end capabilities and can influence technical decisions rather than only execute isolated maintenance tickets.

criteria.label: Engineering quality culture
criteria.description: The team values automated testing, design reviews, type safety, code review, observability, performance measurement, secure development, or reliable CI/CD practices.

criteria.label: SDE 2 growth environment
criteria.description: The role offers mentorship, system-design exposure, increasing service ownership, or a credible path toward broader SDE 2 responsibility without requiring immediate people management.

criteria.label: Compensation quality
criteria.description: Published compensation is competitive for the level and location, or credible evidence indicates market-rate engineering pay. Missing compensation is unknown rather than a mismatch until a minimum target is configured.

signals.label: Verified current opening
signals.description: The role is live on the employer's careers site or another current authoritative hiring source and is not marked filled or closed.

signals.label: Preferred systems overlap
signals.description: The role explicitly mentions distributed systems, microservices, high availability, fault tolerance, load balancing, consistent hashing, rate limiting, queueing, metrics, tracing, latency, or performance engineering.

signals.label: Preferred platform overlap
signals.description: The role explicitly mentions TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, WebSockets, AWS, Docker, NGINX, CI/CD, developer tools, simulation, or infrastructure software.

signals.label: Referral or hiring-manager path
signals.description: A relevant engineer, alumnus, recruiter, founder, or hiring manager can be identified for a targeted referral or direct application follow-up.

signals.label: Remote employment clarity
signals.description: For an international remote role, the listing or employer confirms eligible hiring countries, timezone expectations, and a viable engagement model such as direct employment, employer-of-record, or a compliant full-time contract.

disqualifiers.label: Work authorization mismatch
disqualifiers.description: The employer restricts hiring to a country where the candidate lacks work authorization and offers neither sponsorship nor an India-compatible remote engagement model.

disqualifiers.label: Clearly too senior
disqualifiers.description: The opening requires staff, principal, architect, engineering-manager, or team-lead scope, or makes 7+ years of directly relevant production experience a firm minimum.

disqualifiers.label: Non-development role
disqualifiers.description: The job is primarily manual QA, technical support, implementation consulting, sales engineering, operations, recruiting, or data entry rather than software development.

disqualifiers.label: Unrelated specialist role
disqualifiers.description: The opening requires deep specialist experience in frontend-only UI, native mobile, embedded or firmware, kernel development, graphics, security research, quantitative finance, ML research, or data science with no meaningful path from the candidate's backend and systems background.

disqualifiers.label: Unpaid or pay-to-work opportunity
disqualifiers.description: The opportunity is unpaid, charges an application or placement fee, requires purchasing training, or otherwise asks the candidate to pay to obtain the role.

disqualifiers.label: Unverifiable or stale opening
disqualifiers.description: The listing cannot be corroborated through a credible source, has been removed, is explicitly closed, or shows strong signs of being fraudulent or resume harvesting.

disqualifiers.label: Employment terms mismatch
disqualifiers.description: The role has an unacceptable employment bond, commission-only pay, extreme unpaid trial work, or a location or shift requirement incompatible with the candidate's constraints.
